page_title: Browser Cookie Bridge — Local session transfer for macOS

summary.name: Browser Cookie Bridge
summary.one_liner: A macOS app that moves signed-in browser sessions (cookies, and optionally history or full site storage) between Chromium browsers, ChatGPT Codex, experimental Cursor, and an encrypted Grok Bot file, with optional Browserless Cloud upload.
use_cases: Sign into the same sites across multiple Chromium browser profiles
Transfer a signed-in session into ChatGPT Codex on a Mac
Create an encrypted cookie file for Grok Bot
Schedule local cookie syncs at login or a fixed time
Upload a browser profile to Browserless Cloud
summary.what_it_does: Transfers selected cookies from a source browser to a destination such as another Chromium browser, the Codex app, an experimental Cursor partition, or a Grok Bot .bcbx file. Cookie transfers preserve supported attributes like domain, path, expiry, security, SameSite and partition. History URLs and full site storage (Local Storage, IndexedDB) are optional and only for supported targets. Local transfers run on demand, once at login, or at a set local time, with a menu-bar helper. Codex and Cursor databases are backed up, validated with SQLite integrity checks, and restored on failure. Passwords, Keychain, payment data, bookmarks and autofill are not accessed.
notable: Local-first: browser-to-browser payloads held in memory on a loopback broker, no cookie values in logs
Encrypted .bcbx bundle for Grok Bot that the user attaches manually; the app does not upload it
Codex and Cursor transfers use a separate copy with backup and rollback on failure
Signed and notarized DMG, plus verified Homebrew Cask install
caveats: Cursor import is experimental, cookies-only, and requires Cursor to be fully quit; it does not restart Cursor
Windows is only being explored; no Windows build is promised
Some sites bind sessions to a device or IP and may still require sign-in again
Source browser and Codex must be closed for certain transfers; Browserless requires a closed source profile
